inspiration.observed_pattern: A latest-row derived relation uses NATURAL JOIN on a shared key and timestamp, then NATURAL RIGHT JOIN preserves catalog rows that have no matching latest record.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored sensor catalog report. A derived relation selects each device's latest reading timestamp, NATURAL JOIN recovers its reading payload, and NATURAL RIGHT JOIN preserves a catalog device with no readings. The source view, schema, names, values, and reporting purpose are not copied.

fixture_notes: Device 11 has two readings and must expose only its latest value; device 22 has one reading; device 33 has no readings and must remain with NULL reading fields; device 44 is an orphan reading and must not appear in the catalog report.
determinism_notes: Device IDs, reading timestamps, and values are fixed. The latest relation has one row per device and final output is ordered by the unique catalog device ID; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE sensor_catalog (device_id INT PRIMARY KEY, device_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE sensor_readings (reading_id INT PRIMARY KEY, device_id INT NOT NULL, measured_on DATETIME NOT NULL, reading INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT device_id, device_name, measured_on, reading FROM sensor_readings NATURAL JOIN (SELECT device_id, MAX(measured_on) AS measured_on FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY device_id) AS latest NATURAL RIGHT JOIN sensor_catalog ORDER BY device_id

checks.sql: SELECT device_id, device_name FROM sensor_catalog ORDER BY device_id
SELECT reading_id, device_id, measured_on, reading FROM sensor_readings ORDER BY reading_id
